SyntaxUI Pro - Premium React, Tailwind CSS & Framer UI Components

name: SyntaxUI
summary: Free copy-paste React components and blocks built with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
description: A library of copy-paste React components — buttons, loaders, inputs, tabs, toggles, accordions, steppers — plus page blocks for features, pricing, testimonials, footer, logo cloud and banner, and animated components and effects built with Framer Motion. Free to use, with premium blocks and templates on SyntaxUI Pro.
contains: 15 button variants incl. shimmer, neubrutalism and 3D
14 loaders incl. ripple wave, spinning cube and whirlpool
blocks: features, pricing, testimonial, footer, logo cloud, banner
animations: skewed infinite scroll, hover animations
effects: background, gradients, image fade, emoji confetti
free components plus a paid Pro tier with 50+ premium components
